item.title: PortWin 1.38
item.description:
• Fix Automatically remembers what helped a program and tries it first next time — in a new bottle or after reinstalling.
  • Fix Automatically can share solutions anonymously with other PortWin users: only a fingerprint of the program file and what helped, never names or paths. Solutions that helped others are tried first. Turn it off with the checkbox in the Fix Automatically window.
  • Fix Automatically no longer reports success when a program keeps running without ever showing a window, or closes without one.
  • Programs on .NET Framework that Wine Mono can't run are now recognized: PortWin explains it and Fix Automatically installs .NET Framework 4.8. Also recognized from the log: .NET 6–9, XNA and Managed DirectX.
  • Program settings suggest Wine 11 for 32-bit games on DirectX 8–9: they usually run noticeably faster on it.
